digest.component_or_area: code-review verdict assembly and sidecar integration
propositions: code-review verdict assembly never sets the provider_provenance key, leaving it absent in all signed verdicts despite sidecar expecting it
the plan-review gate (story 343b) fixed this defect for two of three gates but code-review was deliberately excluded and remains broken
provider_provenance must be threaded from the Pass-2 verify agent step through to verdict assembly without recomputation, mirroring the plan-review fix mechanism
the outage/degraded verdict path must omit provider_provenance rather than deriving it from config, as the key's purpose is to record what actually ran
epic acceptance criterion requiring verdicts to state provider, endpoint host, and support tier is unsatisfied for code-review and blocks Bedrock cutover readiness
